name: ✨ Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or new spiritual feature for Dharma Daily
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ["gangasagar5928"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: feature
    attributes:
      label: Feature Description
      description: Describe the feature or scripture addition you would like to see.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: motivation
    attributes:
      label: Value & Spiritual Context
      description: Why would this feature be beneficial to users of Dharma Daily?
    validations:
      required: true
